text:
zoe-marketing: Hey @mike-runtime - small but critical ask for next week's launch blog + webinar. Can runtime build a tiny reproducibility bundle we can link in the post and hand to reporters?

mike-runtime: Sure. What do you want in the bundle?

zoe-marketing: Minimal: 4 payloads (very short, short, medium, long), timings CSV with p50/p95/p99, one cold-start trace, one steady-state trace, a one-paragraph runnote, and a 2-line press-ready blurb with exact numbers. Also a tiny run-local snippet for demos.

priya-eng: Which model & infra? Demo model or flagship?

zoe-marketing: Use rwd-demo-2b on dedicated-gpu-7. Sequence distro: 50% <=64, 30% 65-512, 20% 513-2048. If dedicated isn't available, capture hosted run and caveats.

mike-runtime: Plan: 500 requests, batching off, warmup 40, collect tokens/sec + latencies. I'll include provenance.txt (instance id, driver, docker tag) and payloads.csv with sequence lengths. ETA 24h.

alex-demo: Please include demo/run-local.sh with exact curl + env vars. Need copy-pasteable commands.

mike-runtime: Will add. Example curl in pack: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"rwd-demo-2b","input":"Summarize: ..."}'
```

zoe-marketing: Important: if int8 quantized run is noisy, label it 'preliminary' and include raw traces. Also include sd or variance for p95 so we don't overclaim.

mike-runtime: Agreed. If quantized variance >12% vs fp16 we'll mark as noisy.

bench-bot: micro-bench #122334 queued by mike-runtime. Logs: /bench/122334.

zoe-marketing: Thanks. If Thu EOD looks tight, tell us early; we can drop the long payload.

mike-runtime: Noted. Final deliverables: tar.gz with payloads.csv, timings.csv, traces.tar, provenance.txt, README.md, demo/run-local.sh, press_blurb.txt. ETA ~20h.

bench-bot: micro-bench #122334 complete. Artifacts: /bench/122334/artifacts.tar.gz (sha256: d4f1ab...).
